... access = access[MI->flat_insn->detail->x86.op_count];","note":"Operand detail is populated from a local access array indexed by op_count; if op_count exceeds the initialized access entries, MSAN observes an uninitialized read."},{"step":5,"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"printMemReference","line":742,"var":"MI->flat_insn->detail->x86.operands[MI->flat_insn->detail->x86.op_count].access","code":"get_op_access(..., access, ...); ... operands[...].access = access[MI->flat_insn->detail->x86.op_count];","note":"Memory operands use the same pattern: the printer indexes a stack access table by the current operand count, and the bug is triggered when the instruction shape leaves some entries uninitialized."},{"step":6,"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"X86_Intel_printInst","line":681,"var":"printOperand / printMemReference","code":"The printer emits the instruction and its detail operands for the fuzzed bytes.","note":"The malformed X86 input reaches the sink and causes use of uninitialized data during operand printing."}]')
PY
